_readme: Manual point lights for the ray traced lighting: invisible lights placed by hand where a room has no light of its
own. The game reads this file when it starts and again whenever it changes; the shipped list
(assets/materials/rt_lights.json) adds lights whose id isn't here. Easiest to edit in Eltale Studio (python -m studio
serve, Rooms mode, Ray traced lights), which also takes a player position copied from rt.log.
Only lights with enabled true give light, and only in their area: map and room as decimal numbers, like
rt_emitters.json's only areas (room -1 = every room of the map). position [x, y, z] in game world units (y up; most
floors are at y 0, Brian is about 17 tall). color [r, g, b] 0..1. intensity about 1 like an emitter (a torch 1.2).
range: the distance where the light reaches zero (a room is 150 to 400 across). source radius: the light's size, for
soft shadows. casts shadows: false lets it light through walls (fill light). flicker 0..1: how much it wavers like a
flame (0 = steady); flicker speed: how fast (1 = a torch). placeholder: a guess not checked in game yet.
room settings: per area, {"map": 21, "room": 0, "label": "...", "sun and moon": false} turns the sun/moon light off
there, so only the lights above (and emitters) light it; room -1 = every room of the map, and a room's own entry
overrides the map's. Without an entry the sun and moon are on.
